- **Stewarts_wilt**: young stunted plants, wavy streaks — doesn't match

The test image perfectly matches **Physoderma_brown_spot**: the diagnostic combination of (1) banded yellowish/tan spots on the leaf blade and (2) prominent dark purplish-black lesions along the midrib is unmistakable and unique to this disease.
